summary: Iteration 7 (SERIES + custom OUTRO + error_code + share/reminder UI) validated end-to-end against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL with REELS_MOCK=1. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_reels_seventh_batch.py — 10/10 pytest pass serially in ~17s. Series CRUD: POST /api/series returns full public payload (id/title/premise/tone/characters/episode_count=0 etc); GET /api/series lists it; GET /api/series/{id} returns {series, episodes:[]}; DELETE removes and subsequent GET is 404. POST /api/series/suggest {premise,tone} returns >=1 character in mock mode; empty premise -> 400. POST /api/series/{id}/episode with {} auto-continues (ep1) and with {topic:'The library case'} (ep2). Both episodes reach status='ready' via mock pipeline, series.episode_count increments to 2, and ep1.script != ep2.script (continuity variance verified). Public reel payload for every reel now contains all four new fields: error_code, series_id, episode_number, outro_id (test_new_fields_present_on_plain_reel + episode tests). Outros: POST /api/outros multipart with tiny valid mp4 returns {id,name,size,created_at}; GET /api/outros lists it; POST /api/reels with outro_id echoes outro_id in the public payload; DELETE /api/outros/{id} removes it. Non-video content-type -> 415; empty file -> 400. Frontend (Expo web @ 390x844): Series tab -> new-series-button opens New Series. suggest-characters-button populated 3 chars in mock mode. Add/remove character rows works. create-series-button navigates to /series/{id}. On detail, create-episode-button navigates to /reel/{id} and progress card animates through Writing script -> Voiceover -> Captions -> Rendering. Reel-ready screen (existing ready reel): export-button and remind-button visible; tapping remind reveals reminder-presets with all 4 chips (reminder-1h, reminder-3h, reminder-tonight, reminder-tomorrow); toggling closes them. Create screen: setting-outro row opens OutroSheet showing outro-none, outro-upload button, and existing outro entries; selecting outro-none closes the sheet and updates the row value to 'None'. No red screens; only pre-existing warnings (props.pointerEvents deprecation, expo-notifications not fully supported on web — expected).

minor.issue: Intermittent object-storage 500 from https://integrations.emergentagent.com/objstore/... surfaces to the UI as raw text ('500 Server Error: Internal Server Error for url: ...jpg/.mp4'). classify_error() maps this to error_code='generic' and passes the raw HTTP error string through to the user. Consider a friendlier copy for storage upload failures (e.g. 'Storage upload hiccup — please retry'). Reference: server.py:66-74, storage_client.py:46.

When pytest-xdist runs 2 workers simultaneously the ffmpeg 'moov atom shifting data' step occasionally fails ('Unable to re-open .../reels/{id}.mp4 output file for shifting data'). Reproduces only in parallel; serial run is 10/10. Pre-existing infra behaviour under heavy concurrent ffmpeg I/O — not a new bug.

integration_issues.issue: On web preview the export-button renders with the fallback label 'Download MP4' rather than 'Post to YouTube / Instagram'. Native Share sheet is only available on device — expected. testID export-button is present and tappable.

Tapping a preset chip (e.g. reminder-1h) does not surface save-toast on web because expo-notifications logs 'Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web'. Web preview limitation — UI chips render + are tappable, actual scheduling must be verified on Expo Go / native.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing React 19 warning `props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents`. Not introduced this iteration. Reference: multiple screens (carried over from iterations 2-6).

Warning `[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web` fires on load — expected on web preview; the reminder feature will only work in Expo Go / native builds.

action_items: Optional UX polish: in server.py:66-74 classify_error(), add a branch for storage upload errors (match 'objstore' or 'storage/objects' in the exception message) that returns a friendlier message like 'Object storage hiccup — please retry.' Instead of the raw '500 Server Error...' string that currently reaches the reel detail screen.

Backend infra: the intermittent object-storage 500s from https://integrations.emergentagent.com/objstore/... need attention on the platform side. When this fires, reel.status becomes 'failed' with error_code='generic' even though the render itself succeeded — hurts perceived reliability.

Note: pytest-xdist parallel run has a flaky ffmpeg moov-shift failure on concurrent renders. Consider recommending `-o addopts=''` (serial) for the seventh_batch, or splitting the heavy-render test into its own single-worker suite.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:66-74 classify_error() only branches on budget keywords. Any other pipeline error (storage, ffmpeg, LLM) falls to 'generic' with a raw exception string trimmed to 300 chars — this is what reaches the reel-detail UI. Consider adding a 'storage' branch.
server.py:142-149 PUBLIC_FIELDS correctly includes error_code, series_id, episode_number, outro_id — all four fields verified present in every reel response (plain + episode + outro'd).

server.py:540-617 series routes and episode creation are clean: validates settings, clamps title to 80c, premise 1200c, characters cap 8; auto-increments episode_count atomically via $set; passes series settings to build_reel_doc via ReelSettings(**settings).

pipeline.py:170-213 generate_series_script feeds prior_scripts + character_bible into the LLM prompt for continuity; MOCK branch injects Episode N + topic into a canned script so ep1/ep2 will always differ — continuity assertion in tests passes.
pipeline.py:547-574 append_outro probes the outro clip via ffmpeg -i, normalises to 1080x1920, and concatenates a/v streams. Falls back to anullsrc when the outro has no audio track. Robust.
OutroSheet.tsx:100,114,120,128 has clean testIDs (outro-none, outro-{id}, outro-delete-{id}, outro-upload) — all wired.
reel/[id].tsx:321,329,338 remind-button + reminder-presets + reminder-{id} chips render correctly; scheduling relies on expo-notifications which is web-limited.
server.py:620-660 outro upload validates size (<=40MB), content_type or extension (mp4/mov/m4v). Non-video txt returns 415, empty returns 400 — both verified.

rca_of_issue: During the Playwright run one series-generated reel ended in status='failed' with reel.error='500 Server Error: Internal Server Error for url: https://integrations.emergentagent.com/objstore/api/v1/storage/objects/faceless-ai-reels/reels/{id}.mp4'. Backend log confirms `requests.exceptions.HTTPError: 500` from storage_client.put_object (storage_client.py:46) during the video/thumbnail upload stage of run_pipeline (server.py:346-351). This is an intermittent failure on the Emergent object-storage service, not a defect in the new series/outro code. Mitigation: (a) retry storage_client.put_object with exponential backoff for 5xx; (b) map storage errors in classify_error() to a friendlier 'storage' code so the reel detail screen shows a nicer message than the raw HTTP text.
